findings.message: Timeline callback reaches DOM measurement (getBoundingClientRect/getTotalLength/getComputedStyle/...). The renderer seeks with suppressEvents=false, so callbacks re-fire on every seek, and a cold render worker runs them against whatever DOM state its own non-linear seek order produced. Measured geometry is seek-order-dependent, and values measured at build time (before the callback ran) are stale or zero.
findings.fixHint: Do all measurement and DOM setup synchronously at build time, before registering the timeline, or derive geometry from fixed composition coordinates instead of measuring.
